# Emoji provenance

Messages, names and previews (chat list, search hits, reply bar; these two grey, as their text), reaction picker, quick reactions, reaction chips draw emoji as pictures, not text. Sailfish Qt 5.6 can't draw colour fonts; system fonts know a few hundred emoji at most, monochrome; stock keyboard offers thirty. Other emoji = empty box. So Piirit ships a picture per emoji, as Fernschreiber does on same platform. Text drawn only for emoji with no picture (`qml/components/EmojiGlyph.qml`; in message text, `inText` in `qml/js/Emoji.js`).

Three committed, all generated by `scripts/fetch-emoji.py` (pins inputs, refuses mismatch):

- `qml/js/EmojiData.js`: picker's emoji, Unicode order and groups, English name + keywords for search.
- `qml/js/EmojiPictures.js`: same list as lookup tables drawing needs, no names/keywords, so chat opens without parsing them. `--pictures` rewrites it from committed `EmojiData.js`, offline.
- `qml/art/emoji/*.svg`: one picture each, unmodified. SVG, not Twemoji's 72x72 PNGs: sharp at any drawn size; needs Qt's SVG image plugin (`qt5-qtsvg-plugin-imageformat-svg`).

`--check` fetches both inputs, requires committed copies match byte-for-byte. CI runs it (`ci/vendor-check.sh`).

## Pictures: Twemoji

- **Project:** Twemoji, maintained by jdecked after Twitter stopped.
- **Source:** https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji
- **Version / tag:** `v17.0.3`, commit `b6b55fef1e8636b540a6d016a4729ca8cdf2e60b`
- **Files:** `assets/svg/*.svg`, the ones `EmojiData.js` names.
- **Licence:** [CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Copyright (c) 2014-2021 Twitter, Inc and other contributors; Copyright (c) 2022-present Jason Sofonia & Justine De Caires. Pictures not changed.

## Data: emojibase-data

- **Project:** Emojibase, by Miles Johnson.
- **Source:** https://github.com/milesj/emojibase, published to npm as `emojibase-data`
- **Version:** `17.0.0`, tarball sha256 `d01d0e2ca4e22cb402679532155342c71e2e871f25c32223c013b8b166ebdf5a`
- **Files:** `en/data.json`; kept per emoji: character (spelled as Unicode does: emojibase puts U+FE0F after every lone char, script only after text-default ones), group, order, name, keywords. Skin-tone variants and components group left out.
- **Licence:** MIT, Copyright (c) 2017-2019 Miles Johnson. Names and keywords from Unicode CLDR annotations, under [Unicode License v3](https://www.unicode.org/license.txt), Copyright (c) 1991-2025 Unicode, Inc.

## Updating

Bump `TWEMOJI_TAG` with `TWEMOJI_COMMIT`, or `EMOJIBASE_VERSION` with `EMOJIBASE_SHA256`, in `scripts/fetch-emoji.py`. Run it, update this file. Keep both on same Unicode version: emoji in data with no picture fails script, not drawn as box.
